title: Browser DevTools Understanding Roadmap
goal: Give agents browser understanding beyond text by capturing DevTools-style signals safely: console, network, DOM state, accessibility tree, storage metadata and runtime errors.
no_gpu_strategy: Use headless Chromium and Chrome DevTools Protocol compatible signals; GPU acceleration is not required.

slice_queue.goal: Define redacted console and network event summaries with URL hosts, status classes, timing and error classes.
Summarize DOM and accessibility tree changes across interactions without storing private raw forms or secrets.
Record only safe storage/cookie metadata needed for diagnosis, never values or auth material.
Represent bounded interactions such as click, type, wait and screenshot as auditable steps.

slice_queue.evidence: Debian live smoke captured redacted console/network evidence from https://www.asv-bw.de/ with failed_request_count=0 in reports/autonomy_live/live-smoke.json.
slice_queue.goal: Capture redacted console/network/DOM evidence from an approved public page on Debian.

redaction_rules: Never store Authorization headers, cookies, tokens or form values.
Hash full URLs when query strings may contain private data.
Store host, path class, status code, mime family and timing instead of raw payloads.
Store screenshots only when policy allows the page class.
done_definition: Agents can explain why a page failed using console and network summaries.
Evidence remains useful without exposing secrets.
DevTools evidence can be attached to website research and sandbox result observer runs.
